## Background
The Glider Rodeo field-tested PAM-glider platforms under the same conditions to give data-driven
guidance on what each system can do in different operational environments and for different
research questions. Each glider was flown through a sequence of mission modes:

| Phase | Mode | Start (UTC) | Stop (UTC) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | shakedown | 2026-01-28 22:00 | 2026-01-30 06:00 |
| 2 | fast | 2026-01-30 06:00 | 2026-02-01 18:00 |
| 3 | slow | 2026-02-01 18:00 | 2026-02-04 18:00 |
| 4 | intermediate | 2026-02-04 18:00 | 2026-02-06 18:00 |
| 5 | drift (20 min at 800 m) | 2026-02-06 18:00 | 2026-02-08 18:00 |
| 6 | mini-rodeo: slow | 2026-02-08 18:00 | 2026-02-09 06:00 |
| 6 | mini-rodeo: intermediate | 2026-02-09 06:00 | 2026-02-09 18:00 |
| 6 | mini-rodeo: fast | 2026-02-09 18:00 | 2026-02-10 06:00 |
| 7 | recovery | 2026-02-10 06:00 | |

Source: [Glider Rodeo fieldwork plan](https://nmfs-pam-glider.github.io/GliderRodeo/content/fieldwork.html).

## Goals
Answer, for every glider and mission mode:

- **Piloting:** how do pilots achieve each mission mode (pitch, buoyancy, dive depth, yos per surfacing)?
- **Navigation:** how well does each glider hold the trackline, and how is that affected by currents?
- **Endurance:** how does mission mode affect battery use and data storage?
- **Noise:** how much self-noise (pumping, motors, flow) does each glider make?

## Datasets
- **Glider Rodeo deployment data** (engineering, science, GPS): on the Glider Rodeo JupyterHub in
  `shared-public/GliderRodeo/`, one folder per deployment. Converted to OG1 with glider-og1.
- **Soundscape metrics** (60 s averaged spectra per glider): `shared-public/GliderRodeo/Noise/`.
- **Glider specifications:** `shared-public/GliderRodeo/PAM_Glider_Specs.csv`.

The source data are preliminary. Known issues found during conversion are listed in the
[glider-og1 README](https://github.com/NMFS-PAM-Glider/hackathon-shared-repo/tree/ehsan-abdi/glider-og1#known-data-issues).
